findings.message: The test checks only the first row for each project. The comment says all of AMX's released rows come from the repo's archive and say so (092). But a wrong 'Prod' chip on any AMX row after the first would still pass. The CON check is also only good while CON-009 is the fixtures' only CON release. Fix: read every 'Shipped to' cell in the filtered table, for example with allTextContents(). Then assert that each AMX row says 'Released · from repo' and each CON row says 'Prod'.
findings.scenario: A regression makes releasedLabel return 'In Prod' for a synced AMX proposal that is not first in the sorted list. /delivery/proposals/released?project=AMX still shows 'Released · from repo' in row 1, so the test stays green.
